description: Short-horizon iteration baseline forked from exp731 (FastMHL hard+dense_K, 1.2178 deployment SOTA @ 16k). Single change: n_steps 16000 -> 4000. Purpose: serve as the comparison reference for further 4K-step forks; exp731's final 1.2178 is NOT directly comparable because the LR schedule is 4x shorter and the warm-up fraction (0.1 -> 400 steps here vs 1600 in exp731) reaches peak LR much earlier. The bmm-based wgrad optimisation introduced in src/spiky/lutorch/fast_multi_head_lut.py (sparse-S + bmm for n_outputs>=128 modules) is automatically active and should knock ~10% off the wallclock vs the same recipe pre-optimisation. Otherwise identical to exp731: E=384 NAP-bump arch, bs=24 ga=2 (eff bs=48 sequences/step), Lion lr=2e-4 for LUT, AdamW 3e-4 elsewhere, soft_score_temp=select_temp=0.5, learnable temps, use_bf16=True. Expected wallclock ~65-70 min.
